nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the cyclic permutation $i \mapsto i + 1 \pmod n$ of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is an increasing-cycle permutation.
nodes.title: The cyclic rotation is an increasing-cycle permutation

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the identity permutation of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is an increasing-cycle permutation.
nodes.title: The identity is an increasing-cycle permutation

nodes.summary: A permutation $\tau$ of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is an increasing-cycle permutation when, for all $x$ and $y$ in $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ such that $\tau(x) \le x$ and $y$ lies in the same cycle of $\tau$ as $x$, we have $\tau(x) \le y$. nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $g$ and a multiset $\alpha$ of natural numbers, $C_{n,[\alpha]}^{(g)}$ is the number of increasing-cycle permutations $\tau$ of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ whose multiset of cycle lengths, fixed points counted as cycles of length $1$, is $\alpha$ and whose genus is $g$.

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the genus of the cyclic permutation $i \mapsto i + 1 \pmod n$ of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is $0$.
nodes.title: The one-block partition has genus zero

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the genus of the identity permutation of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is $0$; the identity encodes the partition of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ into singletons.
nodes.title: The partition into singletons has genus zero

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
